snippet.title: NEVERLAND RANCH WEEKEND COMPETITION 1993
snippet.description:
The "Michael Jackson Neverland Competition" occurred in June 1993, with the grand prize winner selected on June 19, 1993. This competition, featured on MTV's "My Weekend at Michael's Neverland Valley Contest," invited fans to submit homemade music videos for his song "Who Is It". Three winners were invited to Neverland for the weekend, where Michael Jackson chose the winner of the video contest. 

Here are the key dates: 
June 1993: The competition took place.

June 19, 1993: Michael Jackson interviewed contest participants and selected the winner for the grand prize.

June 23, 1993: The Los Angeles Times published an article about the contest winners spending the weekend at Neverland.

snippet.title: MICHAEL JACKSONS EMOTIONAL IL BE THERE💔
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson - I'll Be There Pepsi Commercial details : 
The Michael Jackson "I'll Be There" Pepsi advert from 1992 featured the star at a piano, reminiscing about his Jackson 5 days, with his younger self appearing to sing the Jackson 5 hit alongside him. Directed by Joe Pytka, the elaborate commercial incorporated footage from Jackson's Dangerous album and showed a duet with a younger version of himself. The advert was notably shown during his Dangerous World Tour and was the last Pepsi commercial to star the King of Pop.
